ABAFT: पश्चाद्भागे (with gen.): abaft the mast
*गुणवृक्षस्य पश्चाद्भागे।

ABANDONED:
I Lit. त्यक्तः (क्ता, क्तं): v. To
abandon.
II Fig.: extremely wicked: q.
v.
(1) भ्रष्टः (ष्टा, ष्टं);
(2) खण्डितवृत्तः (त्ता, त्तं)
(=of a character).

ABASE:
(1) अभि-भवति (भू, c. 1.);
(2) नमयति
(c. of नम्): v. To humble, to lower.

ABASH:
(1) हेपयति (c. of ह्री);
(2) लज्जयति
(c. of लज्ज्).

ABATE (v. t.):
I To lessen, diminish: q. v.
लघयति (nomi.).
II Leg. t. t., To put down:
q. v.

ABATEMENT:
I Decrease, diminution:
q. v.: ह्रासः।
II Diminution of price: Ph.
I will make an a. of five per cent
*पञ्चकं शतं
 लघयामि।
III Leg. t. t.: v. Failure.
